propositions: A dedicated executor client must be constructed with max_retries=0 and reject if the underlying session has a nonzero max_retries value.
Each DC summary write invocation must perform exactly one GET-PUT-GET sequence: a pre-mutation GET, a PUT write, and a post-mutation GET comparison against the intended summary.

After a PUT fault (ambiguous mutation state), a separate single-attempt GET observation is consumed to determine if the write landed by comparing observed summary to intended value; if equal the outcome is recovered, if unequal the outcome permits replay within remaining budget, and if the GET fails the outcome is non-replaying commit_unknown.

A successful PUT followed by a successful read-back GET yields outcome applied only when observed summary equals intended summary; any mismatch or missing read-back results in commit_unknown without auto-replay.
The injected wrapper policy for selected executor calls must enforce exactly one attempt with no sleep, while legacy wrapper behavior and legacy DC client retry remain unchanged.

Every DC terminal or exhausted outcome or cleanup failure must emit exactly one redacted completion log containing logical id, disposition, invocation count, request count, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and a single message capped at 512 code points, with the entire serialized log not exceeding 1024 code points.
